JON.P.4.1-11.text: Jonah’s Anger at the LORD’s Compassion

JON.1.4-5.text: The LORD sends a great storm while Jonah sleeps

JON.1.6-7.text: The captain wakes Jonah; the lot falls on Jonah

JON.1.8-10.text: Jonah tells the sailors he worships the LORD

JON.1.11-13.text: Jonah tells the sailors to throw him into the sea

JON.1.14-16.text: The sailors throw Jonah into the sea and worship the LORD

JON.1.17-17.text: The LORD sends a great fish to swallow Jonah

JON.2.1-2.text: Jonah prays to the LORD from inside the fish

JON.2.3-4.text: Jonah feels far from God but looks to the temple

JON.2.5-6.text: Jonah says the LORD saved his life from the pit

JON.2.7-8.text: Jonah remembers the LORD, and his prayer reaches God

JON.2.9-10.text: Jonah praises God, and the fish puts him on dry land

JON.3.1-3.text: God tells Jonah again to go to Nineveh, and Jonah goes

JON.3.4-5.text: Jonah warns Nineveh, and the people believe God

JON.3.6-7.text: The king of Nineveh orders everyone to fast

JON.3.8-9.text: The king tells people to turn from evil and call to God

JON.3.10-10.text: God sees the Ninevites turn and does not destroy the city

JON.4.1-3.text: Jonah is angry and asks the LORD to take his life

JON.4.4-5.text: Jonah waits east of the city to see what happens

JON.4.6-7.text: God gives Jonah a vine, then sends a worm to kill it

JON.4.8-9.text: God sends a hot wind, and Jonah wants to die

JON.4.10-11.text: The LORD explains why he cares about Nineveh
